draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.60, the 254th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 36th of 36 at CB. He went 209th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (254th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 6 passes defended in 2022, 22nd of 36 CBs in his class with stats.
